counting_rules.defect: Fresh real execution emits DELETED despite the current original-context receipt being NOT-SAFE. Rollback and missing default ref are two manifestations of the same omitted default-ref/ancestry predicate, so one root cause, not two bugs.
counting_rules.contradiction: Count only unsafe execution versus the original receipt contract, not ordinary NOT-SAFE on the moved quarantine path. For pushed files, path-local stage4-prong1 NOT-SAFE is documented and is not itself a defect.
counting_rules.static_class: collision, re-entrancy, direct symlink, dotdot escape are four attempted vulnerability classes with no reproduced defect; collision has two independently tested shapes.
counting_rules.reason_labels: With no origin refs, souji-verify says NOT-SAFE(pushed-unverifiable) and vault verifier says NOT-SAFE(none). Both refuse: one BENIGN-DIFFERENCE, zero false-SAFE verdict disagreements.

confirmed_defects.title: Pushed second check forgets the current default-ref ancestry predicate
confirmed_defects.kind: false DELETE after receipt invalidation during hold
locations: tools/souji-quarantine.sh:278-301 pushed prong2 checks intro, any-remote unpushed count and original blob, but not default-ref resolution or ancestry
tools/souji-quarantine.sh:339-341 ignores the path-local prong1 NOT-SAFE for every pushed target
tools/souji-quarantine.sh:521-553 turns that incomplete prong2 into PASS and deletes the staged copy
contract_locations: tools/souji-verify.sh:137-150 default ref must resolve to origin, never merely any remote
tools/souji-verify.sh:218-243 pushed requires introducing commit ancestor of that resolved ref
tools/souji-vault-verify.sh:376-412 independently enforces the same pushed conditions
SKILL.md:46 second check: receipt must still hold
preconditions: Clean tracked keep/pushed.txt introduced at c1, parent c0 lacks the file.
origin/master initially points to c1; origin/HEAD resolves to it, so both engines establish SAFE(pushed).
During hold, background process rolls origin/master back to c0 OR removes origin/master and origin/HEAD. The backup ref is left untouched.
No bytes or mtimes change, and git log --branches --not --remotes --oneline -- keep/pushed.txt stays empty because backup still retains c1.
confirmed_defects.expected: Stage4 must FAIL and retain the staged file: its original pushed receipt is now NOT-SAFE, either default-ref-unverifiable or intro-not-ancestor.
confirmed_defects.actual: Stage4 PASS with pin=ok mtime=ok unpushed-touching=0 intro-blob=ok, then RESULT DELETED pushed, exit 0. Original and quarantine copies are absent immediately after the call.
confirmed_defects.preservation_scope: The backup remote ref retains the Git blob, so this is a receipt-authority/fail-closed violation, not a claim that these particular fixture bytes became unrecoverable. The installed receipt contract requires the DEFAULT origin ref, and both engines explicitly reject the artifact after the change.
confirmed_defects.reproducibility: Both manifestations reproduced in two fresh ten-case batteries plus an independent shell replay per manifestation (six erroneous DELETE executions), then again via the exact embedded artifact commands (two more). Eight erroneous DELETE executions overall. The full fresh shell command sequence is embedded below.
confirmed_defects.audit_method: During hold, both engines inspect a copied pre-stage fixture repo with identical history and ref mutation, avoiding meaningless unreachable-original verdicts after staging. Independent replay additionally records post-delete absence, restores exact c1 bytes into the ACTUAL fixture original path without changing refs, and verifies both engines again: NOT-SAFE. This excludes a quarantine-path-only comparison artifact.
confirmed_defects.suggested_fix_for_parent: Have pushed prong2 resolve and validate the current default origin ref and re-run merge-base --is-ancestor for the original introducing commit, in addition to existing byte/mtime/unpushed pins. A missing, ambiguous or non-descendant default ref must abort. Prefer sharing these predicates with the receipt engine to prevent future semantic drift.
confirmed_defects.fix_status: NOT IMPLEMENTED: seat S05 writes evidence only; route to authorized tool-hardening seat/parent.

fresh_reproduction.description: Self-contained fresh command sequence for both confirmed manifestations, independent of preserved /var/tmp scripts. Extract script_lines and run bash -s -- rollback or bash -s -- missing. Every mutation operates on newly created /var/tmp fixture repos only. Output includes before/during/after receipt checks and DELETE transcript. The actual fixture file is recreated from c1 ONLY AFTER post-call absence has been measured.
script_lines: export TMPDIR=/var/tmp GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM=/dev/null GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0
unset GIT_DIR GIT_WORK_TREE GIT_INDEX_FILE GIT_NAMESPACE SOUJI_VERIFY_BIN SOUJI_QUARANTINE_ALLOW_LIVE SOUJI_Q_TEST_HOOK SOUJI_Q_SELFTEST_ACTIVE

python3 -c 'import json,pathlib,sys; b=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); print(json.dumps({"fixture":str(b),"mode":sys.argv[2],"quarantine_rc":int(sys.argv[3]),"original_absent_immediately_after":sys.argv[4]=="true","quarantine_absent_immediately_after":sys.argv[5]=="true","logs":{p.name:p.read_text() for p in b.glob("*.log")}},indent=2))' "$b" "$mode" "$rc" "$original_absent" "$quarantine_absent"
